mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 72 degrees at Harriet Park with overcast skies. While the ISS will be passing overhead tonight, the clouds mean it will not be visible. Tonight will dip to a low of 61 degrees, and please keep your umbrellas handy as rain is in the forecast.

In city news, Highway M will be closed from October 6 through October 9 for essential road work, so please use the posted detours. Additionally, if you need to vote, early in-person voting begins soon at City Hall for the November election.
There is plenty to do in town, starting with Hop Haus Trivia happening today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market or join the trivia night at The Bogey Factory.
On September 21, officers responded to a report of retail theft involving candy at a store on East Verona Avenue, where the individual was identified and cited.
Today's flavor, Caramel Chocolate Pecan, was a treat, but we are now closed for the evening. We look forward to seeing you tomorrow at 09:00 AM when we serve up Dark Chocolate PB Crunch.
